After his Candidates win, Sindarov was awarded the Order of Mehnat Shuhrati (Labour Glory) by the president of Uzbekistan, Shavkat Mirziyoyev.\\n\\nIn May, his 53-game unbeaten streak in classical chess was ended by R Praggnanandhaa in round two of the 2026 GCT Super Chess Classic Romania. In October, he won the rapid tournament Clutch Chess: Champions Showdown ahead of Praggnanandhaa R, Fabiano Caruana and Hikaru Nakamura with a score of 20.5/36.\\n\\nWorld Chess Championship 2026\\n| Javokhir Sindarov (UZB) | 2782 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |\\n| Gukesh Dommaraju (IND) | 2710 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |\\n\\n\",\"**Javokhir Sindarov** (born 8 December 2005) is an Uzbek chess grandmaster.
